answer.rationale: Prioritize an expedited incumbent negotiation tied to renewal: it preserves the proven delivery and integration stability required at 94% line utilization while pursuing the mandated spend reduction through market benchmarking, payment-term improvements, and a multi-year volume commitment. A primary-vendor switch or second-source onboarding creates avoidable near-term delivery risk within the 14-day expiry window. The archived negotiation record should be verified because its achievable savings and timing determine whether this path can credibly support the 18% target.
